facts.fact: ITWeb Africa, citing the Internet Society's IXP Tracker, says Kenya has five active internet exchange points, and that the Kenya Internet Exchange Point in Nairobi has 146 members.
ITWeb Africa, citing the Internet Society's IXP Tracker, says Kenya's five active exchange points are in Nairobi and Mombasa.
ITWeb Africa says Kenya's connectivity depends heavily on subsea cables landing at Mombasa, which carry most of East Africa's international traffic.

KEN.note: Seacom's planned USD 2bn Asia cable (due 2030) and Safaricom's cable application are not in service.
No agreement, building or shared service with another African country stated.
